name: adv_naming_locals_two_instances
source:
// Two instances of the same component: every component-local must be mangled
// per instance (PA.W vs PB.W) and displayed with a dot. No property call, so
// the values are exact and the naming is the only thing under test.
COMPONENT Lift(in, out)
  PARAM v, eta
  out.mdot = in.mdot
  out.h    = in.h + v * (out.P - in.P) / eta
  W        = in.mdot * (out.h - in.h)
END
COMPONENT FluidBoundary(out)
  PARAM P, h, mdot
  out.P    = P
  out.h    = h
  out.mdot = mdot
END
FluidBoundary SRC(f1, P = 100000, h = 112000, mdot = 2.0)
Lift          PA(f1, f2, v = 0.001, eta = 0.8)
Lift          PB(f2, f3, v = 0.001, eta = 0.6)
Sink          SK(f3)
f2.P = 200000
f3.P = 400000
wa = PA.W
wb = PB.W
va = PA.v

error.message: There are 17 equations and 18 variables. The problem is underspecified and cannot be solved. Free quantity (no defining relation): va. Coupled to: pa.v. A common cause: an element chain with no constitutive law for that quantity — e.g. an efficiency-only machine or rigid pass-through between boundaries leaves its through-flow or a port pressure free; add an orifice/valve/flow-map element or pin a boundary value.
